title: VibeShield Finding
description: The atomic unit of VibeShield output. Scanner emits an array of these; every surface (CLI, PR comment, SARIF, dashboard) renders from it.

message.description: The 'why this matters for AI code' explanation, 1-3 sentences, pattern-blame tone

snippet.description: The matched source line(s). Secrets MUST be redacted by the emitter: keep 4-char prefix + 4-char suffix, mask the middle with •

ai_origin.description: confirmed = bot author / co-author trailer / generated marker on the hunk; likely = heuristic; unknown = human-or-unclear

confidence.description: Rule-level confidence this is a true positive

dismiss_hash.description: Stable short hash (rule_id + file + line + normalized snippet) used by /vibeshield accept commands

metadata.description: Category-specific payload. hallucinated-package: {package, version, age_days, maintainers, install_scripts, downloads_monthly, namescore}; hardcoded-secret: {secret_type, redacted}; dependency-risk: {package, version, added_transitive_count}
